lines.text: Forty hours of drawing... [1] lost to forty seconds of A.I.?!
lines.show: 40 hours of drawing... lost to 40 seconds of AI?!
lines.tts: Forty hours of drawing... lost to forty seconds of A.I.?!

lines.text: The rules said original! [1] The AI made it brand new!
lines.show: The rules said original! The AI made it brand new!

lines.text: Who wins is the contest's rule. [1] Who owns it is the law's. So whose poster is it?
lines.show: Who wins is the contest's rule. Who owns it is the law's. So whose poster is it?

lines.text: An American's A.I. picture won an art contest, with six hundred and twenty-four prompts. <pause 0.6> [1] The U.S. refused it copyright: he claimed the A.I.'s part too.
lines.show: An American's AI picture won an art contest, with 624 prompts. The US refused it copyright: he claimed the AI's part too.
lines.tts: An American's A.I. picture won an art contest, with six hundred and twenty-four prompts.
lines.tts2: The U.S. refused it copyright: he claimed the A.I.'s part too.

lines.text: So anyone can copy my poster?!
lines.show: So anyone can copy my poster?!

lines.text: In America, the AI's part has no owner. [1] The parts you made yourself, you can own.
lines.show: In America, the AI's part has no owner. The parts you made yourself, you can own.

lines.text: Our law says: the person who causes it. [1] But no court has tested that on AI.
lines.show: Our law says: the person who causes it. But no court has tested that on AI.

lines.text: And it learned from artists like me, [1] for free!
lines.show: And it learned from artists like me, for free!

lines.text: So I can't use AI at all?
lines.show: So I can't use AI at all?

yt.chapter: Say so, add your own hand
yt.title: Say so, add your own hand

lines.text: Use it, and say so. <pause 0.4> [1] Add your own drawing, and keep your drafts as proof.
lines.show: Use it, and say so. Add your own drawing, and keep your drafts as proof.
lines.tts2: Add your own drawing, and keep your drafts as proof.

lines.text: An AI-only prize? I'm the only entry: [1] I win again!
lines.show: An AI-only prize? I'm the only entry: I win again!
